system.description:
• Effect: You have ki points equal to your Monk level + your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). You regain them all after a long rest.
  • Stun Attack (the default): declare before the attack roll; on a hit, spend 1 ki and the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is Stunned for 1 round (1d4 rounds from 10th level).
  • A miss costs nothing.
  • Once per round; your first stun attempt must be a primary attack.
  • Deals normal unarmed damage.
